title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease and blood pressure management.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally well, though he notes occasional fatigue. He reports compliance with his current antihypertensive medications. He denies any recent changes in urinary output, edema, or significant shortness of breath. He is seeking monitoring of his renal function and blood pressure stability.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Amlodipine 5mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Blood pressure is 132/82 mmHg. Heart rate is 72 bpm. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema noted. Skin is warm and dry.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 3.
2. Hypertension.

Plan
Continue current medication regimen. Order a follow-up BMP and urinalysis to monitor renal function. Patient instructed to maintain a low-sodium diet and schedule a follow-up appointment in three months.
explanations: Hypertension with CKD is presumed linked: I12.9 for CKD stage 1-4 (sequenced first), plus the N18 stage code.

distractors.why: The classification presumes a link between hypertension and CKD.
I12.0 is for stage 5 or ESRD only.
